changes.root_cause: Mark Brown acceptance emails triggered objection patterns (fix/should be).
changes.old_behavior: All comment text could contribute objection patterns regardless of acceptance-email structure.
changes.new_behavior: Acceptance email detector runs before objection classification; acceptance emails are excluded from objection extraction.
changes.why_changed: Reduce false positives from applied/queued maintainer emails.

changes.root_cause: Krzysztof sign-offs (best regards) extracted as blocking objections.
changes.old_behavior: Pattern extraction used full comment text including closing sign-off lines.
changes.new_behavior: strip_signoff() removes trailing sign-off lines; sign-off phrases stored separately in signoff_patterns.
changes.why_changed: Prevent sign-off phrases from polluting objection signal.
changes.evidence_reference: R1 objection pattern list included best regards variants.

changes.root_cause: Pierre-Louis Bossart scope too narrow for Intel/general SoundWire activity.
changes.old_behavior: Scope limited to soundwire qcom + narrow ASoC.
changes.new_behavior: Added soundwire_broad scope and forced 2021-2025 window for Bossart.
changes.why_changed: Increase thread coverage for true reviewer activity footprint.
changes.evidence_reference: R1 fetch_log showed 10 threads for Bossart.
